source: CoursePrewarmTest.reportsTheBinFootprintOfTheSoakCourses (core, desktop JVM), first combined gate run; log in the raw evidence (gate-first-combined.log)
history: 84e8b125 (2026-10-06) moved the bins from 20 m cells to 10 m coarse-to-fine bins: about 0.3M -> 0.7M ints per course by its own message. 54a66fcf made them lazy (before it, every course baked at class load).
limits: Retained bytes are an estimate (payload plus about 20 bytes of header, length and outer reference per bin, padding ignored); ints held are exact. Bins persist for every course visited in a process (Courses keeps built courses). Not a PSS attribution; PSS not fixed here.
